lines.en: label dormwar12:
scene datewar1
: Hi, everyone! Uta Ushibori here!
lines.zh: : 大家好！我是 Uta Ushibori！

lines.en: : It’s a bright and sunny morning, but that doesn’t mean it isn’t cold!
lines.zh: : 今早阳光明媚，不过这不代表就不冷！

lines.en: : And, in case you’re wondering where I am right now, I’d be happy to tell you!
lines.zh: : 要是你们好奇我现在在哪儿，我很乐意告诉你们！

lines.en: : You see, the building right behind me is the {i}exact{/i} location where today’s {i}second{/i} contest is going to be held!
lines.zh: : 你们看，我身后这栋楼，{i}正是{/i}今天{i}第二场{/i}比赛的举办地！

lines.en: : That’s right! This is the outside of the Chosokabe apartment! And joining me today is my very special guest, the first floor’s own...Yumi Yamaguchi!
lines.zh: : 没错！这里是 Chosokabe 家的公寓门外！而今天和我一起的特别来宾，是一楼的……Yumi Yamaguchi！

lines.en: : The fuck is going on right now? Who are you even talking to?
lines.zh: : 现在到底在搞什么鬼？你到底在跟谁说话？

lines.en: scene datewar2
: So, Yumi...any insight on today’s competition?
lines.zh: : 那么，Yumi……对今天的比赛有什么见解吗？

lines.en: : It seems that you know Chika better than anybody else in the class, so we’re hoping you can shine some light on a few of her strategies or...tactics she might be using to defeat Touka today.
lines.zh: : 看起来全班里你最了解 Chika，所以我们希望你能透露一点她今天用来击败 Touka 的策略或者……战术。

lines.en: : Am I getting paid for this shit?
lines.zh: : 干这种破事有钱拿吗？

lines.en: : You’re being paid in exposure! It’s a completely valid form of currency that everyone accepts and appreciates without question! Trust me!
lines.zh: : 你的报酬是曝光度！这可是完全正当的货币形式，所有人都毫无疑问地接受并欣赏它！相信我！

lines.en: scene datewar3
: Hah...whatever. What was the question again?
lines.zh: : 哈……随便吧。你刚才问什么来着？

lines.en: : Actually, let me ask you this instead...
lines.zh: : 其实，我换个问题吧……

lines.en: : No disrespect to Chika, but this is a very low income area and isn't exactly an ideal location for a date.
lines.zh: : 我无意冒犯 Chika，不过这一带是低收入地区，实在算不上约会的理想地点。

lines.en: : Are you at all worried about the effect of Touka’s money on the outcome of this competition?
lines.zh: : 你担不担心 Touka 的钱会影响这场比赛的结果？

lines.en: scene datewar4
: Uhh...not really. No.
lines.zh: : 呃……不太担心。不担心。

lines.en: : In fact, if there’s anything I know about Chika, it’s that she’ll use all of the bein’ poor shit to her advantage.
lines.zh: : 事实上，要说我对 Chika 有什么了解，那就是她会把“穷”这件事全部利用起来，变成自己的优势。

lines.en: : How can one use their {i}lack{/i} of money to their advantage?
lines.zh: : {i}没{/i}钱怎么能变成优势呢？

lines.en: : You know...just make herself look all pitiful and shit so our pervert teacher will feel bad and choose her to be a white knight or whatever.
lines.zh: : 就是……把自己弄得可怜兮兮的，好让我们那个变态老师于心不忍，选她当什么白骑士之类的。

lines.en: scene datewar5
: I see, I see! Leave it to the Queen of Hearts to know both her opponent {i}and{/i} her man!
lines.zh: : 原来如此，原来如此！不愧是红心皇后，既了解对手，{i}又{/i}了解她的男人！

lines.en: : The queen of...wha?
lines.zh: : 什么皇后……啥？

lines.en: scene datewar6
: It’s the nickname we’ve given to Chika! Not only because of her heart hairpin thingy, but because she seems to know the most about love and stuff out of all of the girls!
lines.zh: : 那是我们给 Chika 起的绰号！不只是因为她那个心形发卡，还因为所有女生里，她看起来最懂爱情什么的！

lines.en: : Chika doesn’t know shit. She just watches a bunch of those sappy movies with her little sister. Not really experience.
lines.zh: : Chika 懂个屁。她只是跟她妹一起看了一堆肉麻电影而已。那算不上经验。

lines.en: : Do you think {i}you{/i} could do any better, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}觉得你能做得更好吗，Yumi？

lines.en: scene datewar7
: I think you better get the fuck away from my house before I beat the shit out of you.
lines.zh: : 我劝你趁我还没把你打扁，赶紧他妈滚出我家。

lines.en: : Well, there you have it! I’m Uta Ushibori with the...news thing! Back to you guys in the studio!
lines.zh: : 好了，就是这样！我是 Uta Ushibori，来自……那个新闻节目！交还给演播室的各位！

lines.en: : Stay tuned for full coverage of all date-related stuff, as Makoto Miyamura will be holding an interview with none other than Tsubasa Tsukioka in just two short hours!
lines.zh: : 敬请锁定本台对所有约会相关内容的全程报道——短短两小时后，Makoto Miyamura 将专访 Tsubasa Tsukioka 本人！

lines.en: scene black
: Uhh...hello?
lines.zh: : 呃……有人在吗？

lines.en: I knock on Chika’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Chika 家的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I could have sworn I saw Uta on the way here, but now that I look around again, I don't see anyone at all.
lines.zh: 我明明记得路上看见了 Uta，可再环顾一圈，却一个人都没有。

lines.en: So I’m starting to doubt that this is even part of the dorm war and that Chika just wants to have sex or something.
lines.zh: 所以我开始怀疑这根本不是宿舍大战的一部分，而是 Chika 单纯想跟我上床什么的。

lines.en: Either way, fine by me.
lines.zh: 不管哪种，我都无所谓。

lines.en: I just hope that Yumi is watching Chinami or something because...I’m not really sure how I’d explain something like that to her.
lines.zh: 我只希望 Yumi 这会儿在看着 Chinami 什么的，因为……我真不知道该怎么跟她解释这种事。

lines.en: : Sensei, is that you? You can come on in!
lines.zh: : Sensei，是你吗？进来吧！

lines.en: scene datewar8
: Hey! Perfect timing!
lines.zh: : 嘿！来得正好！

lines.en: : I just finished making breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我刚把早饭做好。

lines.en: : Well...I guess, it’s not really breakfast. But like, it’s kind of that weird period after breakfast but before lunch.
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实也算不上早饭。就是那种早饭之后、午饭之前的奇怪时段吧。

lines.en: : I believe that is called “brunch.”
lines.zh: : 我记得那叫“早午餐”。

lines.en: : What’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene datewar9
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that this obviously isn’t part of the contest, so I want to know if you’re planning something or-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这显然不是比赛的一部分，所以我想知道你是不是在打什么算盘，还是——

lines.en: scene datewar10
: Papa!
lines.zh: : 爸爸！

lines.en: : Not yet, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 还没到时候，Chinami。

lines.en: : Nevermind!
lines.zh: : 没事了！

lines.en: scene datewar9
: Well, I guess {i}that{/i} won’t be happening.
lines.zh: : 嗯，看来{i}这事{/i}是发生不了了。

lines.en: scene datewar11
: This {i}is{/i} part of the competition. But that doesn’t mean it isn’t something I've been wanting to do anyway.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}比赛的一部分。不过这也不代表它不是我本来就一直想做的事。

lines.en: : It’s just...I don’t have much money, so I can’t take you on some lavish or exciting date or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 只是……我没多少钱，所以没法带你去什么豪华又刺激的约会。

lines.en: : All I can really give you is...me. And who I am and...what I am and...all of that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 我真正能给你的只有……我自己。我是谁、我是什么样的人……以及所有那些东西。

lines.en: : So...the competition is who can take me on a better date?
lines.zh: : 所以……比赛内容是看谁能带我进行一场更好的约会？

lines.en: scene datewar12
: Lucky me, right?
lines.zh: : 我运气好吧？

lines.en: : I kind of had to like, semi-blackmail Makoto to get this competition approved, but that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: : 为了把这个项目通过，我算是半威胁了 Makoto 一下，不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene datewar13
: Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别在意。

lines.en: : The point is...even though I don’t always have free time...and I can’t really afford the kind of stuff I’m sure you’ll be seeing later-
lines.zh: : 重点是……虽然我不是总有空闲……也确实负担不起你待会儿肯定会看到的那种排场——

lines.en: : I want you to see that I...I can still make the most of our time together and...what little there is of it.
lines.zh: : 但我想让你看到，我……我还是能充分利用我们在一起的时间……哪怕那点时间少得可怜。
: 所以……

lines.en: : Chinami! Now!
lines.zh: : Chinami！就是现在！

lines.en: scene datewar14
: Papa!
lines.zh: : 爸爸！

lines.en: : What is happening?
lines.zh: : 到底在发生什么？

lines.en: scene datewar15
: If you would please follow Chinami, she would like to show you to your table for the afternoon.
lines.zh: : 请您跟随 Chinami，她想带您去您今天下午的座位。

lines.en: : Today’s main course is a timeless Chosokabe favorite- instant curry made with love!
lines.zh: : 今天的主菜是 Chosokabe 家永恒的经典——用爱做成的速食咖喱！

lines.en: : The mild kind because Chinami can’t have spicy food.
lines.zh: : 是微辣的，因为 Chinami 不能吃辣。

lines.en: : What-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : Silence, Papa! Big Sis worked very hard all morning making sure Chinami wouldn’t mess this up, and so she must stick to the plan!
lines.zh: : 安静，爸爸！姐姐为了不让 Chinami 搞砸，一早上都特别努力，所以 Chinami 必须按计划行事！

lines.en: scene datewar16
: We should probably listen to her before she kicks us out.
lines.zh: : 我们大概还是听她的吧，免得她把我们赶出去。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess we should.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。

lines.en: : This way, please.
lines.zh: : 这边请。

lines.en: scene black
Chinami ushers us through the bedroom and out onto the balcony.
lines.zh: Chinami 领着我们穿过卧室，走到阳台上。

lines.en: There’s a table I haven’t seen before pressed up against the corner, overlooking my least favorite part of the city.
lines.zh: 角落里摆着一张我从没见过的桌子，正对着这座城市我最不喜欢的那一角。

lines.en: But, somehow or another, it doesn’t make me uneasy.
lines.zh: 可不知为什么，它并没有让我感到不安。

lines.en: In fact, I feel more at home here than I’ve felt in quite a while.
lines.zh: 事实上，我在这里感到的归属感，比很长一段时间以来的任何地方都要强。

lines.en: And I’m sure that a large portion of that is because the Chosokabe family dynamic is infectious, but that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定其中很大一部分原因是 Chosokabe 家的家庭氛围太有感染力了，不过这不是重点。

lines.en: It’s not much.
lines.zh: 这里没什么特别的。

lines.en: But what it is works well.
lines.zh: 但它的样子刚刚好。

lines.en: scene datewar17
: It’s not too cold out, is it?
lines.zh: : 外面不算太冷吧？

lines.en: : I checked the weather like six hundred times last night making sure it wasn’t going to rain, and it’s like a whole ten degrees colder than it was supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 我昨晚查了大概六百遍天气预报，确认不会下雨，结果现在比预报的整整低了十度。

lines.en: : Is that fine? Or do you want to go back inside and maybe like...improv this part of the date?
lines.zh: : 这样行吗？还是你想回屋里，把约会这一段……即兴发挥一下？

lines.en: : It’s fine, don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事，别在意。

lines.en: : Also, has this table always been here?
lines.zh: : 还有，这张桌子一直在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么问？

lines.en: : It’s just strange that we haven’t done something like this before.
lines.zh: : 只是有点奇怪，我们以前居然没做过这种事。

lines.en: : It’s new, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实是新的。

lines.en: : Well, not {i}new{/i}. But we got it today.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也不算{i}新{/i}。不过是我们今天弄来的。

lines.en: : After I left your room this morning, I came back home with Yumi and the two of us walked around town looking for people who might be throwing away an old table and chairs.
lines.zh: : 今早从你房间离开后，我和 Yumi 一起回了家，然后在城里转悠，看有没有人要扔掉旧桌子和椅子。

lines.en: : We had to make a couple trips to carry everything back but, as you can see, we got it done in the end.
lines.zh: : 我们来回跑了好几趟才把东西搬回来，不过你也看到了，最后还是弄成了。

lines.en: : You did that just for today?
lines.zh: : 你们就为了今天干这个？

lines.en: : And for the future.
lines.zh: : 也为了以后。

lines.en: : I obviously don’t want this to be the only time the two of us can kind of...separate ourselves from how busy or...unfortunate life can be at times.
lines.zh: : 我当然不希望这是我们唯一一次能……从生活的忙碌或者……时不时冒出来的不幸里抽身出来。

lines.en: : So if I need to get a little dirty and barter with some creepy old people to make that happen, I’m fine with it.
lines.zh: : 所以如果为此我得弄脏点、跟一些古怪的老头老太讨价还价，我也无所谓。

lines.en: : You do so much for me. The least I can do is make you feel like you belong.
lines.zh: : 你为我做了那么多。我至少能做的，就是让你有归属感。

lines.en: scene datewar18
I sit down at the table and have a hard time finding anything to say in response to all of that.
lines.zh: 我在桌边坐下，很难想出什么话来回应这一切。

lines.en: Just this morning, I was making my relationship with Chika sound like some one-sided affair for no reason other than...not hurting Io’s feelings or something.
lines.zh: 就在今天早上，我还把我和 Chika 的关系说成是什么单方面的纠缠，理由仅仅是……不想伤 Io 的心之类的。

lines.en: Why did I do that again?
lines.zh: 我到底为什么要那么说？

lines.en: scene goodmorningio22
scene datewar18
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Right.
lines.zh: 对了。

lines.en: Because I’m pathetic.
lines.zh: 因为我很可悲。

lines.en: Because I can't be satisfied by just one beautiful girl.
lines.zh: 因为光有一个漂亮的女孩满足不了我。

lines.en: I need all of them.
lines.zh: 我需要她们所有人。

lines.en: Perhaps in another life, I’d take Chika’s hand.
lines.zh: 也许在另一段人生里，我会牵起 Chika 的手。

lines.en: The two of us would leave this scavenged table together and I’d march back over to the diner, dragging her by the wrist, and introduce her to everyone as my girlfriend.
lines.zh: 我们会一起离开这张捡来的桌子，我拽着她的手腕一路走回那家餐厅，把她作为我的女朋友介绍给所有人。

lines.en: She would graduate years later and we’d begin to grow old together.
lines.zh: 几年后她会毕业，然后我们开始一起变老。

lines.en: We’d get married.
lines.zh: 我们会结婚。

lines.en: Maybe have a child or two.
lines.zh: 也许生一两个孩子。

lines.en: We’d get sick.
lines.zh: 我们会生病。

lines.en: Die.
lines.zh: 然后死去。

lines.en: And then go to sleep one final time, in plots right next to one another.
lines.zh: 最后在紧挨着的两块墓地里，睡上最后一觉。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: scene datewar19
: H-Hey...
: Wh-what’s this all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎、怎么突然说这个？

lines.en: : It’s...embarrassing when you just come out and say it out of nowhere like that.
lines.zh: : 你这样毫无预兆地说出来……很让人难为情啊。

lines.en: : It’s what you were about to do, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你本来也打算说这个吧？

lines.en: : Well...
: Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: Perhaps in another life, the three words she loves more than the world itself would not carry so much weight.
lines.zh: 也许在另一段人生里，那三个她爱得不亚于整个世界的字，不会承载这么重的分量。

lines.en: Perhaps in another life, I would be able to say them and mean them.
lines.zh: 也许在另一段人生里，我能说出那三个字，并且真心实意。

lines.en: Or perhaps I wouldn’t.
lines.zh: 也或许我还是做不到。

lines.en: It’s not really something that someone like me could ever know.
lines.zh: 这种事，像我这样的人永远不可能知道。

lines.en: There’s no way to know anything in this world. Not when it continues to spin as quickly and change as rapidly as it does every single day.
lines.zh: 在这个世界上，没有任何事情是能确定的。尤其当它每天都转得那么快、变得那么急的时候。

lines.en: But, for a brief moment in time, the spinning stops.
lines.zh: 但有那么一瞬间，旋转停了下来。

lines.en: The changing stops.
lines.zh: 改变也停了下来。

lines.en: And, in a time where I least expect it-
lines.zh: 而就在我最意想不到的时刻——

lines.en: Chika and I exist.
lines.zh: Chika 和我存在着。

lines.en: Not just as people. Not just as a couple.
lines.zh: 不只是作为两个人。不只是作为一对情侣。

lines.en: But as us.
lines.zh: 而是作为“我们”。

lines.en: I am me. She is her.
lines.zh: 我是我。她是她。

lines.en: We are us.
lines.zh: 我们是“我们”。

lines.en: That is all.
lines.zh: 仅此而已。

lines.en: O, world.
lines.zh: 噢，世界。

lines.en: Why must I destroy everything I touch?
lines.zh: 为什么我非得毁掉我触碰过的一切？

lines.en: : You’re going to win this competition.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛你会赢的。

lines.en: scene datewar20
: I mean...{i}obviously.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}那当然{/i}。

lines.en: : But we’ve barely even started, and to say that before Touka even goes...
lines.zh: : 可我们才刚开始，在 Touka 还没上场之前就这么说……

lines.en: : Why now?
lines.zh: : 为什么是现在？

lines.en: : Because you deserve it.
lines.zh: : 因为这是你应得的。

lines.en: : And I don’t deserve you.
lines.zh: : 而我配不上你。

lines.en: It’s funny how the moments we least expect are the ones that always change us.
lines.zh: 真可笑，最出乎意料的时刻，往往就是改变我们的时刻。

lines.en: Which is not to say that I’ve changed.
lines.zh: 但这并不是说我改变了。

lines.en: I will hurt this girl more times than she can bear.
lines.zh: 我会伤这个女孩，伤到她承受不住的次数。

lines.en: I will ruin everything.
lines.zh: 我会毁掉一切。

lines.en: I will destroy her world.
lines.zh: 我会摧毁她的世界。

lines.en: But I will not have wanted any of it.
lines.zh: 但这一切都不是我想要的。

lines.en: I do not change.
lines.zh: 我没有改变。

lines.en: But a part of me does.
lines.zh: 但我的一部分改变了。

lines.en: Or did.
lines.zh: 或者说，曾经改变了。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: But such is the art of never knowing.
lines.zh: 但这就是“永远无法确定”的艺术。

lines.en: Something that resembles love digs its jagged fingernails into my beating heart and sinks its teeth in once it's inside.
lines.zh: 某种类似爱的东西，用它参差不齐的指甲抠进我跳动的心脏，一旦钻进去就狠狠咬下。

lines.en: It’s not much.
lines.zh: 那不算多。

lines.en: But it’s enough for me to say it to her without feeling like a complete liar.
lines.zh: 但足以让我对她说出那句话，而不至于觉得自己是个彻头彻尾的骗子。

lines.en: For the kind of love that Chika both has and wants is the kind that exists to be traded between two entities.
lines.zh: 因为 Chika 拥有且渴望的那种爱，是一种只在两个个体之间交换的爱。

lines.en: And that kind of love does not exist to me.
lines.zh: 而那种爱对我来说并不存在。

lines.en: Nothing exists to me.
lines.zh: 对我来说，什么都不存在。

lines.en: I wish it did.
lines.zh: 我希望它存在。

lines.en: scene datewar21
: Chinami has returned!
lines.zh: : Chinami 回来了！

lines.en: : Please help yourselves to-
lines.zh: : 请各位随意享用——

lines.en: scene datewar22
: Chinami is in trouble, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : Chinami 惹麻烦了，是吧？

lines.en: scene black
